title: M5 stage 4 draft: exact quotient cardinality and period bound
scope: Two period-bound targets importing the verified accepted stage3 quotient_finite theorem

spec.name: M5.Period.quotient_cardinality
spec.statement: ∀ F : M5.BinaryPolynomial, F.Monic → Nat.card (AdjoinRoot F) = 2 ^ F.natDegree
spec.guidance: Use Nat.card_congr ((AdjoinRoot.powerBasisAux' hF).equivFun.toEquiv), whose target is functions Fin F.natDegree → ZMod 2. Simplify the function-space Nat.card via Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin and ZMod.card. The degree-zero case is already covered by the empty-index basis; do not add F ≠ 1 or irreducibility. Return only tactic lines without a leading by.

spec.name: M5.Period.period_cardinality_bound
spec.statement: ∀ F : M5.BinaryPolynomial, F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → M5.signaturePeriod F ≤ 2 ^ F.natDegree
spec.guidance: Install the local Finite (AdjoinRoot F) instance from accepted M5.Period.quotient_finite. Unfold M5.signaturePeriod and apply orderOf_le_card to AdjoinRoot.root F. Rewrite Nat.card with the accepted quotient_cardinality theorem. The coeff-zero assumption matches the original M5 signature domain; the estimate itself need not use it. Preserve ≤ 2^degree, including F=1. Do not add a strict inequality or a nonconstant restriction. Return only tactic lines without a leading by.
